step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture depicts a multi-account setup vended and managed by AWS Control Tower. Developers push code/images to ECR in their individual vended accounts ('1-n'). From ECR, deployments go to a centralized EKS cluster in the runtime account. EKS communicates through AWS Transit Gateway in a networking account back to resources like S3 in the developer accounts. Control Tower governs these vended developer accounts directly. Seven nodes (DEV actor, ECR, RDS, S3, EKS, Transit Gateway, Control Tower) and five visual directional arrows are identified and mapped into sequential flow paths.
